response.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_amt, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS avg_amount, AVG(avg_bal) AS avg_balance FROM acc GROUP BY region), tot AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall FROM reg) SELECT reg.region, reg.avg_amount, reg.avg_balance, reg.avg_amount * 1.0 / tot.overall AS ratio FROM reg CROSS JOIN tot WHERE tot.overall IS NOT NULL
